name: Andaz Munich Schwabinger Tor
positioning: Design-led Andaz lifestyle hotel at Schwabinger Tor in Munich's Schwabing, near the English Garden, with a rooftop pool and spa
best_for: Design-conscious travelers who want a contemporary base in Schwabing
Guests who want a rooftop pool and spa with city views
Travelers with dogs or young children

facts.text: The hotel is near the English Garden, with the Schwabing neighborhood just outside.
The hotel is designed for a modern, design-conscious traveler, with generous, light-filled interiors.
Rooms feature wooden floors, designer sofas, art and modern bath amenities.
Rooms include a complimentary minibar with non-alcoholic beverages and snacks, and exclusive Saskia Diez x Andaz Munich bath toiletries.
Courtyard garden rooms open onto the Andaz courtyard garden, on a quieter side of the hotel.
The Andaz Art Suite has a loft-style layout and a unique art wall.
The spa hosts weekly Studio.12 sessions, from Pilates to aqua workouts, and the hotel has a 24/7 fitness center.
Schwabinger Tor Bräu is a neighborhood Wirtshaus and in-house brewery serving house-brewed beers.
The Lonely Broccoli is a meat house focused on charcoal-grilled and slow-roasted cuts and dry aging.
From Easter to October, guests can use complimentary bicycles.
Dogs are welcomed with the Very Important Dog program, including a designer dog bed from Munich-based FLUM; the Very Important Baby program provides baby cribs, children's menus and toys.
The Parzivalplatz tram stop is directly in front of the main entrance, with Tram 23 to Münchner Freiheit.

highlights.text: A rooftop pool and spa, with views from the spa toward the Olympic Park.
M'Uniqo Rooftop Bar on the 13th floor, with views across Munich and toward the Bavarian Alps.
Tower rooms look toward Munich's skyline and the Alps beyond.
The 11th-floor Penthouse Suite has a private bar with an Andaz foosball table and a freestanding hot tub in the bathroom.
In-house guests get a complimentary wine, beer and snack hour daily at the Andaz Lounge.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 3.8 kilometers from the city center at Marienplatz.
The garage at Schwabinger Tor is directly connected to the hotel but independently operated, not by the hotel.
